text:
Priya: quick callout — we need a concise 'span grammar' for LLM request traces. current mix of names + model ids is killing cardinality in our trace index.
Liam: +1. can we standardize on short operation names and push model/variant as attributes only? e.g. `op=invoke`, `op=kv_cache_lookup`?
Caro: I like op-only names. proposal: span.name = `llm.request` / `llm.kv.lookup` / `llm.kv.populate` and then attributes for semantics.
Devin: agree but we also need something human-friendly in the console links. maybe keep a compact suffix: `llm.request · gen` where the dot-suffix is stable and low-card.
Priya: good idea. concrete attribute set I want to test:
```
redwood.op = "request"
redwood.model.id = "gpt-xyz-7b"
redwood.model.variant = "q4_0"
redwood.tokens.prompt = 42
redwood.tokens.generated = 128
redwood.kv.cache_hit = true
redwood.kv.cache_ttl_s = 3600
redwood.customer.id = "cust_123"  # hashed in exporter
```
Liam: fyi we must avoid free-text prompts in attributes. strip/hashed customer identifiers before storing. for model id, also consider mapping to a short code in pipeline to reduce index bloat.
Caro: what about exporter retention levels? full spans for 30d, aggregated traces/metrics for 1y? also, sampling: keep all error traces + a small % of successful traces, but ensure we keep 100% of cache-miss traces for model regressions.
Devin: +1. propose rule set:
- route to otlp-collector -> enrich -> anonymize -> exporter
- keep `redwood.kv.cache_hit` unmodified so we can slice by cache effectiveness
- retention tier A (30d raw traces), tier B (90d tail traces + metrics), tier C (1y aggregated stats)
Priya: need to call out dashboards: add a dedicated filter key `redwood.trace_key` that maps to `model:variant:op` for quick dashboarding without indexing the full model name.
Liam: question: do we put `model` attribute on the span or only on the root trace? Some requests spawn multi-span ops (router -> model -> postproc).
Caro: put model on the model-inference span only. router span should have `redwood.route_policy` and `redwood.quota_bucket`. that'll keep cardinality controlled while still searchable.
Devin: small perf note: storing numeric token counts as ints helps metrics pipeline; avoid storing token arrays.
telemetry-bot: RFC draft updated: https://go.redwood/rfc/telemetry-span-grammar (edited) :thumbsup:
Priya: action items: 1) Liam to prototype collector mapping to short model codes, 2) Caro to update span naming docs with examples, 3) Devin to draft sampling rules for cache-miss prioritization. will sync Friday.
Liam: ack, starting a branch with mapping table.
Caro: I'll add console mockups for the `redwood.trace_key` quick filter.
Devin: I'll write the sampling config and add unit tests for the exporter anonymizer.
Priya: thanks everyone. keeping span names stable = big win for index cost. :rocket:
